funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage who have a confirmed publisher and a publication date scheduled within three years of applying.
opportunities.summary: Provides financial support of up to £6,000 for authors to publish monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles that reflect advanced research in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) – Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to ERBA members (or pending members) who are researchers needing travel support for library/archive/collection visits or related events.
opportunities.summary: Provides a travel bursary of up to £250 to cover transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses for a specific research‑related trip.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit (collaborative applications welcome). One grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Provides flexible support of up to £40,000 for organisations undertaking ambitious, sustained research projects in British art, visual culture or architectural history.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition may be forthcoming or already held.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to produce publications related to exhibitions and displays, covering costs such as image licensing and production.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking digitisation of its own collections.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 to support digitisation projects that make collections freely available online.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcome.
opportunities.summary: Supports organisations to disseminate research through live, online or hybrid events for a variety of audiences.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking conservation research on items in public or charitable ownership.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £25,000 to help protect and preserve significant works of British art through original conservation research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to individuals at any career stage (up to £3,000 and £3,001‑£8,000 tiers) and post‑doctoral level or above (up to £20,000).
opportunities.summary: Provides flexible financial support for research travel and/or research time to address specific research questions in British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals enrolled in or about to start a master’s‑level or doctoral‑level degree in British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Provides a fixed £5,000 to support students beginning or continuing postgraduate study in the field.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered undergraduate or higher students (any nationality) researching eighteenth‑ or nineteenth‑century British works on paper.
opportunities.summary: Provides a £2,000 grant to support travel for research on historic works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours).

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives – Master's Degree Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer (or already holding an offer) for a UK‑based master’s programme (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) beginning between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Provides full‑fee and living‑cost support for a master’s degree to bring new perspectives to British art research.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives – Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: £96,000 total (£32,000 per year for three years)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals with an offer (or already holding an offer) for a UK‑based doctoral programme beginning between April 2027 and April 2028; open to UK and international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Provides full tuition and living‑cost support for a doctorate, aiming to expand understanding of British art through new perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives – Early Career Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post‑doctoral level individuals (or equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding to undertake a major research project that will reshape understanding of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship (British School at Rome)

amount.raw: Full board, accommodation and honorarium for three months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals (pre‑doctoral to senior) with at least a first degree.
opportunities.summary: Provides a three‑month residency at the British School at Rome for advanced research on British‑Italian topics.
